name: Avala Crew
description: Sastaviš ekipu od 5 ljudi za Avala festival noć. Biraš ko ide, dodeliš uloge, i vodiš ekipu kroz 10 scenarija — od Sabiranja do Rastanka. Sinergije, Aftermath efekti, i share karta na kraju.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point, screen manager, game flow wire, all ability handlers
modules.src/config.js: Sve tuning konstante — thresholds, XP, scoring, Bond krive, role modifiers
modules.src/state.js: Game state shape, localStorage save/load, career/bond/prestige tracking
modules.src/input.js: Event delegation click/touch handlers via data-action attributes
modules.src/ui.js: Screen manager, showScreen, toast, modal, prestige prompt
modules.src/render.js: Card DOM element creator, CSS pixel art portrait, phase timeline
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API — lo-fi techno ambient, phase transitions SFX, 128BPM peak
modules.src/share.js: Canvas 1200x630 share card generator + Web Share API + PNG fallback
modules.src/entities/crewMember.js: CrewMember class: effectiveStats, getContribution, useAbility, applyPassive
modules.src/entities/scenario.js: Scenario class: getOutcomeText, getAftermath, hasChoices, phase/type labels
modules.src/systems/resolution.js: resolveScenario() pure function — CrewScore formula, outcome, scoreGained
modules.src/systems/scenario_selector.js: Seeded pseudo-random selector with phase guarantees (L,S/E in Gathering etc)
modules.src/rendering/roster_renderer.js: Full roster screen HTML: card grid, slots, role dropdowns, synergy panel
modules.src/rendering/scenario_renderer.js: Scenario screen: phase timeline, card, aftermath bar, crew bar, abilities, resolution
modules.src/rendering/outro_renderer.js: Outro screen: Night Score, outcome, crew summary, scenarios, what-if, share, CTA
modules.src/content/crew_data.js: Sva 12 crew member statična data (stats, traits, abilities, unlock uslovi)
modules.src/content/scenarios_data.js: Svih 20 scenarija (S01-S08 Sabiranje, V01-V07 Vrh, R01-R05 Rastanak)
modules.src/content/synergies_data.js: Svih 12 sinergija (8 starter vidljive + 4 hidden unlock)
modules.styles/base.css: Layout, full-screen 480px, responsive grid, scrollbar, typography
modules.styles/ui.css: Card design, roster grid, scenario card, buttons, modal overlay, outro
modules.styles/game.css: Card animacije, synergy sparkle, phase transitions, aftermath, resolution overlay
modules.styles/theme.css: Avala brand paleta — dark green/night blue/neon green/amber/electric blue
